web_refactor.intent: Ferrite web refactor review. The agent is editing a page crate in the web-dev lane. Check the complete changed file and its diff against the web specification: one tab-page/<tab>.rs orchestration file, page-unique components in components/, shared components and semantic style tokens in ui-components, one content rsx per component, state next to its consumer, EventHandler boundaries, user-facing copy in constants, and zero behavior drift (testid/aria/class/four states/button order). Flag only evidence visible in the file or diff; do not infer behavior from a path name alone.

has_refactor_debt.instructions: Does this complete file or diff leave a web refactor issue described by the web specification?

criteria.true: At least one page-shape, style, shared-component, composition, state, i18n, documentation, or behavior-drift issue is visible in the changed file or diff.
criteria.false: The file and diff show the target page-crate shape and shared primitives with no observable refactor debt.

page_shape.instructions: Does the file or diff keep or create a flat tab-page-* directory when the page should use tab-page/<tab>.rs plus components/?

criteria.true: A tab-page-users/, tab-page-keys/, tab-page-settings/, or equivalent flat tab directory is present or created outside the canonical tab-page/ directory.
criteria.false: The path is tab-page/<tab>.rs, components/<name>.rs, api.rs, or a root-level state/format/shared module; a legitimate crate that has not yet migrated is not a violation unless this diff creates or preserves the old path.

style_unification.instructions: Does the diff add or preserve a repeated semantic Tailwind style combination that should be a ui-components constant or style component?

criteria.true: A semantic combination such as a card shell, modal shell, input shell, section header, focus shell, or empty/error state is written inline in more than one page/component and is not represented by ui::styles, CARD_SHELL_CLASS, MODAL_*, FIELD_PANEL, or a shared style component.
criteria.false: Only atomic utilities are used, or the semantic combination is already centralized and the diff references that shared constant/component.

shared_component_ownership.instructions: Does the diff keep a component local even though the file or diff shows a second real page use or an interface that is clearly shared?

criteria.true: A component has a second real use outside its page crate, or the diff visibly duplicates a page component with only prop/text differences instead of moving it to ui-components.
criteria.false: The component is used once inside its page, or the shared component already lives in ui-components and the page imports it.

composition_discipline.instructions: Does the diff violate the rsx composition rules: nested element trees, inline loop bodies, multiple content rsx blocks, or rsx closures that contain API calls and multi-signal writes?

criteria.true: A tab-page file nests meaningful UI more than one level deep, has an inline for-loop with state derivation or nested rsx, has a non-slot second content rsx, or an rsx closure contains spawn/API work plus three or more business statements.
criteria.false: The page reads as named section/component calls, loop bodies are item components, stateful components keep one content rsx, and only slot-connection rsx remains inline.

state_and_interaction_boundary.instructions: Does the diff put private state in the page, put cross-component state inside a child, or let a child component call the API and mutate external state directly?

criteria.true: A child owns state needed by siblings, a component self-uses state in the page layer, or a child calls ApiClient/spawn and writes multiple external signals instead of exposing EventHandler/props.
criteria.false: Private use_signal stays in the component, cross-component state stays in the tab-page, and API/EventHandler boundaries are explicit.

i18n_constants.instructions: Does the diff put user-facing Chinese copy directly in rsx element bodies instead of a page/root constant?

criteria.true: A tab-page or components rsx element contains visible Chinese text that is not a constant, test selector, numeric symbol, or unit-only literal.
criteria.false: Visible copy uses LBL_/BTN_/SEC_/MSG_/FIELD_/OPT_ constants, or the changed text is only a comment/test fixture.

component_documentation.instructions: Does a newly added or materially changed public #[component] lack the six-element documentation required by the web specification?

criteria.true: A public component has no module/function rustdoc or is missing the observable sections describing what it is, what it does, interaction, style, child composition, and data flow.
criteria.false: The component has the required six-element rustdoc, or the file only changes a private implementation detail without changing the public component contract.

behavior_drift.instructions: Does this refactor diff visibly change behavior that H1 requires to remain byte-for-byte stable?

criteria.true: The diff changes data-testid, aria role/label, a visible class string, loading/error/empty/data branches, button text, or button order while claiming to be a structural refactor.
criteria.false: The diff only moves code, extracts components, updates imports, or replaces an inline semantic class with the identical shared constant; no observable contract changes are shown.

primary_refactor_kind.instructions: Classify the primary refactor need visible in this file and diff. Use mixed when two or more non-trivial categories apply.

criteria.page_shape: The primary issue is an old tab-page-* directory or wrong page-crate module shape.
criteria.style_unification: The primary issue is duplicated semantic styling that belongs in ui-components.
criteria.shared_component: The primary issue is a component that should move to shared ui-components.
criteria.composition: The primary issue is rsx nesting, loop-body extraction, multiple rsx blocks, or closure extraction.
criteria.state_boundary: The primary issue is state ownership or API/EventHandler boundary.
criteria.i18n: The primary issue is user-facing copy not using constants.
criteria.documentation: The primary issue is missing six-element component documentation.
criteria.behavior_drift: The primary issue is a structural diff that changes an observable UI contract.
criteria.mixed: At least two of the other categories apply.
criteria.no_action: The file already satisfies the target shape and shared-component/style rules.

refactor_severity.instructions: How urgent is the refactor work for the web-dev lane?
criteria: 0: The file already follows the target page-crate shape and uses shared primitives; no refactor work is needed.
1: A minor issue such as one flat directory or one repeated semantic class can be fixed in a later web slice.
2: The current diff creates a flat page shape, duplicates a component/style that should be shared now, or breaks the rsx composition/state boundary.
3: Multiple pages are left with duplicated styles/components, or a structural refactor changes observable UI behavior and blocks web-dev -> main release.

release_blocker.instructions: Should this finding block the web-dev -> main release until the refactor is dispositioned?

criteria.true: The evidence shows release-scale duplication, a structural diff that changes H1 behavior, or a new page shape that bypasses the canonical page-crate contract.
criteria.false: The issue is a local advisory, a single-file style opportunity, or a missing comment that does not alter runtime behavior.
